info.description:
The JSON interface to a HyperUplink board, exposing the same
categories, forums, topics and administrative surfaces the web
interface serves, with every response shaped by the permissions
of the user the API key belongs to.

Authentication happens with an API key that a signed-in user
mints under Account -> API on the board itself, and the secret
it hands out once is sent either as a bearer token in the
Authorization header or verbatim in the X-API-Key header, so a
request that carries neither is answered with 401 before it
ever reaches a controller.
info.title: HyperUplink API

get.description:
Lists every category the caller may see together with the forums
inside it and the board-wide counters.

A category the caller may not read is answered as though it did not
exist, so that the board gives nothing away about what it hides.
Lists one page of the forum's topics, newest activity first.

parameters.description: The page to return, counting from one
parameters.name: page

get.description:
Lists one page of the topic's replies together with the poll, the
attachments and the read marker of the calling user.

parameters.description: The page to return, counting from one
parameters.name: page

post.description:
The reply is addressed by the slugs in the path, and everyone
subscribed to the topic is notified once it has been stored.

A vote is final and can only be cast while the poll is still open,
and the results are what the topic hands back afterwards.

put.description:
The current password has to be sent along with the new one, and a
user with two-factor authentication enabled has to add a current
one-time code as well.

parameters.description: The current and the new password
parameters.name: request

get.description:
Returns the caller's own record together with the profile fields the
board has enabled and the values the caller has filled in.

post.description:
The picture is resized and converted by the board, so any format
ImageMagick reads is accepted as long as it stays under the size
limit the administrators have set.

parameters.description: The image to use as the account picture
parameters.name: profile_picture

Flips whether the named section of the interface starts out open or
closed for the caller and answers with the state it now has.

get.description:
When two-factor authentication is off this hands out a fresh
enrollment with the secret and the otpauth URL to scan, and when it
is already on only the enabled flag comes back.

post.description:
The otpauth URL handed out by the enrollment is sent back together
with a code generated from it, which proves the authenticator app
holds the same secret.

parameters.description: The otpauth URL and a code generated from it
parameters.name: request
